title: The list color function threshold of K_{2,l}
scope: tau(K_{2,l}) =Theta[atTop] sqrt l over l in Nat, for tau the list color function threshold, the smallest k >= chi(G) with P_l(G,m) = P(G,m) for every m >= k, defined by sInf over a set proved nonempty, on the actual mathlib completeBipartiteGraph (Fin 2) (Fin l). Also: for m >= 4 and 2l <= (m-1)^2, every m-assignment of K_{2,l} has at least m(m-1)^l + m(m-1)(m-2)^l proper list colourings.
source_targets: Kaul, Kumar, Mudrock, Rewers, Shin, To, arXiv 2202.03431, Conjecture 5
validation: Seventeen modules compiled and kernel-checked from an empty build by an independent reviewer, who read every module; a transitive closure of 27,763 constants has only the three permitted axioms and no unsafe or partial constant; Lean controls prove P(G,m) equals the colouring count, that any colour type relabels into Nat, and instance independence of tau; statement fidelity PASS against the source and the literal. Root verified receipts, hashes and the mathlib pin, and read and hand-checked the paper.
substantive_reason: Settles a deliberate conjecture stated with an explicit lower bound and reasserted in the follow-up, which says a proof will require a novel refinement of its approach or an entirely new approach. The best published upper bound was linear in l; the result gives the conjectured order sqrt l with an explicit bound. No read theorem yields it, and the printed lemmas do not: only Lemma 6 of the follow-up is used as printed.
contrary_scope_assessment: This is a close call and significance is recorded as modest. The proof is about a page of Bernoulli and AM-GM. Every tool appears in the follow-up, its Lemma 13 and the proof of its Lemma 15 contain the AM-GM steps, its Lemma 5 gives the containment reduction, the architecture is that of its Theorem 7 made uniform in m, and the theorem adds nothing at small m. Both adversarial reviewers recommended credit at low-to-moderate confidence; the second said a root exclusion on significance would be defensible and compared 342017, excluded as a one-page literal proof. Root distinguishes 342017 because there the reviewer recommended exclusion and the literal followed in three lines from a printed source lemma plus short machines. The user may overrule.
novelty_standard: Qualified bounded source-primary investigation, not worldwide priority certification.
prior_limits: No citation index. The J. Graph Theory final of the source, DOI 10.1002/jgt.23045, returned 403, is closed and unread, so whether it changes Conjecture 5 is unknown. arXiv 2505.05662, 2509.16733 and 2607.16810 were read in part only. Registry roots closed.
process_adjudication: Disclosed and judged non-substantive: one read-only directory listing and console redirections outside the runners; displays slightly over the 15000-character limit in several lanes; failed receipts kept in the manuscript and control work; three authored qualification files written through the writer without runner receipts; a post-seal read-only check in the manuscript lane, whose two files lie outside that lane manifest, verified by root. Certificate content rests on the fresh replay and independent audit rather than on those histories.
trust_limits: Upstream Lean, mathlib and their oleans are trusted through pins and were not rebuilt. Reviewers are AI systems, not human referees, and the reviewers and the final Lean author share a model family; the formal proof follows the first reviewer's route. Colours are Finset Nat; the relabelling and instance-independence bridges exist only in the auditor's control modules. The every-larger-m clause is separated from equality at k only for k below the chromatic number, since a separation at k >= chi would answer the source's open Question 2.
paper_corrections: Root removed status wording, reworded attributions, completed one citation, added one disclosure and fixed page layout; see qa/ROOT-CORRECTIONS.json. The proof was not changed.
